releases.title: EasySupport 2.3.0 — Your guild, your dashboard
releases.summary: A complete guild dashboard replaces the old status-focused experience, bringing module setup, staff access, and update notes into one searchable, responsive workspace.

Highlights: Introduced a Discord sign-in guild dashboard with guild-scoped access for server managers.
Added configuration pages for tickets, moderation, anti-nuke, automod, leveling, economy, giveaways, vouches, welcome and boosts, and logging.
Added per-guild staff role permissions for commands, with administrator bypass and Discord permission fallback.
Dashboard experience: Redesigned the public site and dashboard with responsive layouts, bundled fonts and images, and motion effects.
Search modules and commands from the guild overview.
Find guilds, channels, categories, and roles through searchable selectors, including multi-select staff-role controls.
Navigate between the overview and settings without reloading the page, while preserving browser history and back navigation.
Added animated Save/Saved controls, save-status notifications, and an animated loading state when opening another guild.
Release updates: Connected the dashboard release feed to published GitHub releases, with caching and a direct source link.
Added a local release-notes generator for maintainers to draft notes from Git history.
Reliability and maintenance: Resolve static asset paths from the application location so assets load when the process starts outside the repository directory.
Use valid Discord CDN image sizes for guild icons and user avatars.
Read the OAuth callback URL from environment configuration.
Expanded test coverage and ensured database connections are closed after ticketing tests.
Moved guild and module setup into the dashboard instead of legacy command-driven setup panels.
